research_question: What is the effect of kappa-opioid agonists compared with placebo on pruritus severity (0-10 cm VAS) in participants with uremic pruritus in parallel-group trials?
outcome_description: Pruritus severity measured on a 0-10 cm Visual Analogue Scale (VAS)
positive_direction: A positive effect size indicates greater reduction in pruritus severity, favoring the kappa-opioid agonist over placebo.
search_queries: kappa opioid agonist uremic pruritus trial
difelikefalin nalbuphine nalfurafine pruritus randomized controlled trial
kappa opioid receptor hemodialysis pruritus VAS quantitative effect
inclusion_criteria: Participants with uremic pruritus / chronic kidney disease-associated pruritus receiving a kappa-opioid agonist or placebo
Parallel-group controlled trial design comparing a kappa-opioid agonist (e.g., difelikefalin, nalbuphine, nalfurafine) against placebo
Reporting quantitative measurement of pruritus severity using a Visual Analogue Scale (VAS)
exclusion_criteria: Not an original empirical study (systematic reviews, meta-analyses, editorials, letters, and theoretical papers are excluded)
No comparison between a kappa-opioid agonist and a placebo control group
No quantitative pruritus outcome data sufficient to calculate an effect size (means and standard deviations or standard errors required)
Non-parallel designs (e.g., crossover trials) or completely unrelated patient populations/conditions
effect_size_note: Mean difference (MD) on the 0-10 cm Visual Analogue Scale (VAS) for pruritus severity, pooled using random-effects meta-analysis across parallel-group trials.
